snippet.title: v8.2 Roving Among Clouds Trailer - Honkai Impact 3rd
snippet.description:
v8.2 Roving Among Clouds coming soon! Li Sushang's new S-rank battlesuit Peregrine Sword debuts!
Stay tuned for Part 2 Main Story Chapter VIII: Till the Long Road Reaches the Sky, featured event Yunchin's Culinary Wonders, and new outfits!
